column1: # EXP-R2-226: what protein continued pretraining bought on a protein task.
# Three rungs of one lineage -- Llama-2-7b-hf -> ProLLaMA_Stage_1 -> ProLLaMA -- on
# the two frozen protein-capability queues, all three under the IDENTICAL bare
# Seq=<...> block. Stage 2's declared instruction form is deliberately not used on
# any rung: a true superfamily would be an L15-class conditioning leak on the
# quantity being measured and a fabricated one would put a false fact inside the
# measurement.
# bfloat16 on every rung and at both endpoints, EXP-R2-226's declaration. The
# released checkpoints declare float16, so the load is a declared cast, identical
# on all three rungs, which is what the paired difference requires. Everything
# else is each stage's own default, which is what the existing artefacts on these
# queues were produced at: stage 20 at --variants 1000 --seed 20260807
# --batch-size 16, stage 29 at --batch-size 512, which is that stage's published
# setting rather than its argparse default of 256 and is therefore stated.
# Slot 1 is the all-or-stop qualification gate, one rung per card: strict load
# with Transformers' loading diagnostics exposed, a fixed-sequence NLL self-check
# run twice, and -- on the adapted rungs only -- a directional-reversal control
# that must cost strictly more than 0.05 nats per scored token. The base rung is
# exempt from the third clause and enters as a DECLARED FLOOR, not as a qualified
# protein arm: its measured reversal cost is -0.0013 nats per scored token.
# Slots 2 and 3 refuse to score a rung whose slot-1 artefact is absent, is not
# PASS, or was taken at another precision, so "an arm is scored only after every
# clause holds" is executable here rather than a sentence in a log entry. That is
# also why every scoring cell names its own rung's qualification directory.
# Cells of one slot are the same shape and the same size, so the queue's hard
# inter-slot barrier waits on comparable durations rather than on one long cell.
# Both score stages read an input out of their own --out, which this runner
# injects: 20_retrieval_bound.py's score reads wildtypes.json and
# 29_designed_referent.py's reads cohort.json. Both are staged into each cell's
# output directory before dispatch, and neither is a cell's expect basename -- an
# input staged beside a result is not completion, which is why expect names the
# model payload exactly.
